correctness.rationale: For positive a,b,c, compute T(2^a3^bq^c)=2^a3^{b-1}q^{c-1}(2q+1). Since 2q+1 is odd and congruent to 1 modulo q, closure forces this factor to be a power of 3. Conversely if 2q+1=3^h, induction explicitly eliminates the q-part in c steps, the 3-part in b+(h-1)c steps, and the remaining 2-part in a+b+(h-1)c steps. Total length a+2b+(2h-1)c and one-option SG parity a+c. The proof handles all a,b,c>=1 and all primes q>3; separate finite replay tests 168 exponent triples and 59 nonqualifying primes. No infinitude of q is assumed.

value.rationale: The 2021 and 2023 papers explicitly motivate classification of cototient game heights beyond two-prime supports. This supplies a natural complete classification of invariant supports {2,3,q} uniformly over every prime q>3, an exact orbit at all positive exponents, and an explicit winning/losing parity. It is an infinite three-support family (already q=13 or q=1093 suffices) rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice or a previously tabulated value; no paper-sized downstream result is claimed.
